invoices_description: Bills for completed orders and other fees, from draft to paid.
invoices_nothing_to_bill: Nothing to bill: no completed orders or fees that aren't invoiced yet.
invoices_billed_meanwhile: Some of these were billed on another invoice meanwhile. Reload and try again.
invoices_only_billable_orders: Only the customer's completed orders that aren't billed yet
invoices_only_billable_items: Only the customer's items that aren't billed yet
invoices_choose_something: Choose at least one order or item to bill
invoices_choose_to_add: Choose orders or items to add
invoices_not_editable: {number} has been issued and can't be changed
invoices_add_before_issuing: Add something to bill before issuing the invoice

match.countPlural=one: {orders} isn't completed anymore; remove it first
match.countPlural=*: {orders} aren't completed anymore; remove them first

invoices_void_draft_description: The draft is kept under its number but bills nothing; its orders and fees can go on another invoice.
invoices_void_sent_description: The invoice is kept under its number but no longer bills anything: its orders go back to completed, and its orders and fees can go on another invoice.
invoices_issue_description: It's dated today and can't be changed afterwards; its orders become invoiced.
invoices_new_description: Bill a customer for their completed orders and fees; it starts as a draft.
invoices_what_to_bill_description: Completed orders that aren't invoiced yet, priced as on their page, and fees that are due.
invoices_what_to_bill_choose: Choose a customer to see what they can be billed for.
invoices_add_description: {customer}'s completed orders and fees that aren't invoiced yet.
invoices_add_line_description: For anything else, e.g. travel costs.
invoices_terms_description: The VAT rate is the organization's when the invoice is issued.
invoices_vat_rate_description: Fixed on an invoice when it's issued.
invoices_payment_term_description: For new drafts; each draft can have its own.
invoices_bill_from_description: Other modules' fees (e.g. service contracts) are billed from this day on.
invoices_receivables_description: What customers owe on invoices sent, less their credit notes, including VAT.
invoices_overdue_description: Sent and past their due date, most overdue first.
invoices_nothing_overdue_description: Every sent invoice is still within its payment term.
invoices_once_completed: It can be invoiced once it's completed.
invoices_bulk_create_description: A draft invoice for their customer, with those that are completed and not on an invoice yet. You can check it before issuing it.
invoices_bulk_mark_paid_description: Records that they were paid today. Only sent invoices can be marked paid.
invoices_module_description: Invoices for completed orders and other modules' fees, with VAT, PDF download and receivables on the dashboard.
invoices_credit_add_line_description: Anything else to credit, e.g. a goodwill amount.
invoices_credit_against_description: What's left of it to pay after its credit notes.
invoices_credit_card_description: What's credited of this invoice, and what's left to pay.
invoices_credit_closing: We credit you {amount} with credit note {number}.
invoices_credit_discount_hint: A line that's a discount (a negative amount) is taken back when you credit it.
invoices_credit_elsewhere_description: Its lines and its reason come from another module, so they can't be changed here. Issue it as it is, or void it.
invoices_credit_invoice_description: Choose what to credit of {customer}'s invoice: whole lines, or part of one. It starts as a draft.
invoices_credit_issue_description: It's dated today and can't be changed afterwards; settle it once it's refunded.
invoices_credit_issue_offset_description: It's dated today and can't be changed afterwards. It's taken off what {number} leaves to pay; once nothing is left, {number} is paid by its credit notes.
invoices_credit_left: {amount} of the invoice is left to credit, before VAT. Everything left starts checked: that credits it in full.
invoices_credit_lines_elsewhere: {number} was made by another module, so its lines can't be changed
invoices_credit_lines_of_invoice: A credit note against an invoice credits that invoice's lines only
invoices_credit_more_than_invoice: That's more than is left of the invoice to credit ({amount} before VAT)
invoices_credit_more_than_line: {description}: at most {amount} is left to credit
invoices_credit_new_description: Credit a customer without an invoice, e.g. a goodwill gesture. To credit an invoice, start from its page.
invoices_credit_not_creditable: {number} can't be credited: only sent or paid invoices can
invoices_credit_notes_description: Credits to customers, against an invoice or on their own, from draft to settled.
invoices_credit_offset_pending: Taken off what the invoice leaves to pay: settled when it's paid.
invoices_credit_only_sent_or_paid: Only sent or paid invoices can be credited, as long as something of them is left to credit.
invoices_credit_reason_description: Printed on the credit note, e.g. "Returned part".
invoices_credit_reason_elsewhere: {number} was made by another module, so its reason can't be changed
invoices_credit_reason_required: Say why the customer is credited
invoices_credit_to_refund: {amount} to refund to {customer}; mark it settled once that's done.
invoices_credit_unknown_line: Only the invoice's own lines can be credited
invoices_credit_void_description: The credit note is kept under its number but no longer credits anything.
invoices_void_has_credit_notes: {number} has credit notes ({credits}): void them first
